# pve_ceph_mon (Resource)

One Ceph monitor on a node (creating the first monitor auto-creates a manager).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_ceph_mon" "example" {
monid = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monid` (String) The ID for the monitor, when omitted the same as the nodename. (default: nodename)
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `mon_address` (String) Overwrites autodetected monitor IP address(es). Must be in the public network(s) of Ceph.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/monid (also the `terraform import` format).
